apps.description:
- Notes App — What’s New
- A major update packed with productivity, performance, security, and cloud features.
- Move & Copy to Folder
- Single or bulk notes can now be moved/copied to existing folders, Root, or a newly created folder.
- Compact Selection Mode
- Clean responsive grid with Import, Delete, Share, Vault, Move, Copy & Cloud Export actions.
- Background Cloud Export
- Export notes/folders to Google Drive, TG Drive, or Both with live upload progress—even when the app is minimized.
- Real-Time Access Tracking
- Live note view/access counts with shared-link origin tracking and instant sync.
- Smart Trash
- Safe delete → Trash → Restore anytime. Permanent deletion is instant, with automatic 30-day cleanup.
- Clean Folder Navigation
- Folders stay organized without mixing notes into the main folder list. Export folders as Cloud backups or ZIP archives.
- Advanced Import
- Import multiple MD, TXT, JSON files, complete folders, ZIP backups, or content directly from URLs/shared links.
- Enhanced Dashboard
- Recent, edited, opened, and most-accessed notes with interactive widgets and live updates.
- Smart Editor Auto-Scroll
- Smooth automatic scrolling while writing or editing notes.
- Secure Vault
- Protect sensitive notes with Fingerprint, Face Unlock, or PIN.
- Grid & List Views
- Switch between rich visual Grid View and compact, fast-scrolling List View.
- More productivity. Better organization. Stronger security.
